# Simpleasyty

Language indexes: [Deutsch](https://simpleasyty.com/llms-de.txt) · [日本語](https://simpleasyty.com/llms-ja.txt)

> Simpleasyty builds focused Atlassian Forge apps for governed, dependable work in Confluence Cloud.

## Products

- [Simpleasyty home](https://simpleasyty.com/): Brand overview for Simple Tables and Simple Metadata.
- [Simple Tables for Confluence](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/): Interactive tables, Page Properties reporting, imports, calculations, filtering and exports.
- [Simple Metadata for Confluence](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/): Compliance-ready structured page data with schema templates, validation, permissions, history and reports.
- [Compare products and alternatives](https://simpleasyty.com/compare/): Switch between Simple Tables and Simple Metadata comparisons.
- [Changelog](https://simpleasyty.com/changelog/whats-new/): Release notes for both apps.
- [Support](https://simpleasyty.com/support/): Simpleasyty support portal and startup troubleshooting.

## Simple Tables Help Center

- [Introduction](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/introduction/): Product overview and core concepts.
- [Install Simple Tables](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/install/): Installation for Confluence Cloud administrators.
- [Quick start](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/quick-start/): First table setup.
- [Paste data](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/paste/): Paste CSV or JSON directly into a Simple Table macro.
- [Use a page attachment](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/attachments/): Build a table from a CSV, JSON, or Excel file attached to the current page.
- [Upload a file](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/file-upload/): Upload CSV, JSON, XLS, or XLSX from your computer.
- [Join tables](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/join-tables/): Join two published Simple Tables on the same page using Inner or Left joins, available in version 8.0.0.
- [Page Properties](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/page-properties/): Live reports from Page Properties macros.
- [Confluence Content](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/confluence-content/): Live tables built from Confluence pages found with CQL.
- [Jira Issues](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/jira-issues/): Planned Jira integration and its Marketplace availability constraint.
- [Native Confluence tables](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/confluence-tables/): Add interaction while preserving native table content.
- [Table Excerpt / Include](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/table-excerpt/): Add interaction to centrally managed, reusable Confluence tables.
- [Save table data on the page](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/save-attachments/): Store a table source with its Confluence page as an attachment.
- [Atlassian Store: table data in Forge](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/forge-storage/)
- [Data residency](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/data-residency/): Storage and residency information for Simple Tables data.
- [No data egress](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/data-egress/): External data-flow boundary for the app.
- [Calculated columns](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/calculated-column/): Formula-driven columns.
- [Filters](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/filters/): Configured, hidden and composable filters.
- [Grouping](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/grouping/): Grouped table views.
- [Pivot tables](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/pivot-tables/): Pivot-style summaries.
- [Download CSV or Excel](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/download-csv-excel/): Export controls.

## Simple Metadata Help Center

- [Simple Metadata demo](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/demo/): The schema-to-report workflow.
- [Introduction](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/introduction/): Schema-driven metadata as a compliance evidence layer.
- [Quick start](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/quick-start/): Create a schema, capture an entry and report across pages.
- [Schemas, fields and templates](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/schemas/): Structured definitions, templates, constraints and defaults.
- [Indexed fields and filters](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/indexing-and-filters/): Typed reporting filters and reconciliation.
- [Schema permissions](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/permissions/): Restrict schemas by space, label and group.
- [Capture metadata](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/capture-macro/): Page-level capture, validation and repair.
- [Capture, validate and repair an entry](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/capture-entry/): Save and review a page-level record.
- [Metadata reports](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/report-macro/): Cross-page reports, columns and exposed filters.
- [Report filters and viewer controls](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/report-filters/): Fixed filters and safe reader controls.
- [Entries, history and revisions](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/entries-and-history/): Live entries, snapshots and schema versions.
- [Import and export](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/import-export/): JSON/YAML packages and schemas-only import.
- [Schema reconciliation](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/reconciliation/): Review schema-change impact and background processes.
- [Security and limits](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/security-and-limits/): Forge SQL, Forge KVS, retention and known limits.
- [Troubleshooting](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/troubleshooting/): Eligibility, indexing and report-result checks.

## Crawling notes

The site is static HTML and can be crawled without running application-specific JavaScript. Simple Metadata supports evidence and review workflows, but does not issue official certifications or replace an accredited assessor.

## Additional documentation and resources

- [Confluence Databases vs Simple Tables](https://simpleasyty.com/compare/confluence-databases-vs-simple-tables/): Compare Confluence databases and Simple Tables for structured records, page tables, file imports, calculations, views, and published reporting workflows.
- [Native Confluence Tables vs Simple Tables](https://simpleasyty.com/compare/native-confluence-tables-vs-simple-tables/): Understand when a native Confluence table is enough and when Simple Tables adds useful search, filtering, grouping, calculations, imports, and export.
- [How to Calculate Totals in a Confluence Table](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/calculate-totals-in-confluence-table/): Calculate sums, averages, counts, minimums, and maximums in Confluence tables with footer and grouping aggregations.
- [How to Create a Pivot Table in Confluence](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/create-pivot-table-in-confluence/): Create pivot-style summaries in Confluence with Simple Tables by choosing row dimensions, values, and aggregations.
- [How to Export a Confluence Table to Excel](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/export-confluence-table-to-excel/): Enable CSV and Excel downloads for a Simple Table in Confluence and understand which displayed values are exported.
- [How to Filter a Table in Confluence](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/filter-table-in-confluence/): Add table filtering in Confluence using Simple Tables search, column behavior, grouping, and data types.
- [How to Group Rows in a Confluence Table](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/group-rows-in-confluence-table/): Group Confluence table rows by status, owner, region, or another column and add aggregations to each group with Simple Tables.
- [How to Import CSV into Confluence](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/import-csv-into-confluence/): Turn CSV data into an interactive Confluence table with search, sorting, grouping, calculated columns, and export.
- [How to Import Excel into Confluence](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/import-excel-into-confluence/): Import XLS or XLSX data into an interactive Confluence table with Simple Tables, then configure columns, search, grouping, and export.
- [How to Sort a Table in Confluence](https://simpleasyty.com/guides/sort-table-in-confluence/): Learn how native Confluence sorting works and how to add persistent, interactive sorting with Simple Tables.
- [Simple Metadata documentation — Simpleasyty](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-metadata/docs/): Start with the schema-to-report workflow, then explore schemas, capture, reports and administration.
- [Grouping Aggregation — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/column-aggregation/): Choose how grouped columns summarize their values: Sum, Avg, Min, Max, Count, Count distinct, and Mode.
- [Column colors — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/column-colors/): Apply a background color and text color to a specific column from Columns > Display.
- [Drag & Drop Columns — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/column-reordering/): Learn how to reorder table columns with drag and drop in Simple Tables for Confluence Cloud.
- [Confidential Label — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/confidential-label/): Add a clear confidential-content notice above sensitive Simple Tables.
- [Column Data Type — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/data-type-column/): Set the right data type for each column — Text, Number, Date, Boolean, or Enum — and fine-tune formatting for clear sorting, filtering, grouping, and display.
- [Delete Column — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/delete-column/): Remove unnecessary columns from your table configuration.
- [Expression Functions — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/expression-functions/): Reference for expression syntax and supported function categories in calculated columns.
- [Footer Aggregation — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/footer-aggregation/): Choose how the table footer summarizes columns: Count, Count distinct, Sum, Avg, Min, Max, and Mode.
- [Full Screen Mode — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/full-screen-mode/): Let readers open Simple Tables in a larger focused view.
- [Hide Columns — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/hide-column/): Learn how to hide and show columns in Simple Tables for Confluence Cloud.
- [Incognito Mode — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/incognito-mode/): Use Incognito mode to show selected column content only to users who can edit the Confluence page.
- [Layout and spacing — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/layout-and-spacing/): Choose the table density and spacing that make a Simple Tables view easiest to review.
- [Nested JSON Fields — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/nested-json-fields/): Extract and use nested fields from JSON structures to create rich, dynamic tables.
- [Pagination — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/pagination/): Learn how readers browse long Simple Tables results with automatic pagination and rows-per-page controls.
- [Rename Headings — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/rename-heading/): Learn how to rename column headings in Simple Tables for Confluence Cloud.
- [Rovo — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/rovo/): Use Ask Rovo to analyze a focused Simple Tables view in Confluence.
- [Row Numbers — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/row-numbers/): Add a stable row-number column to make Simple Tables easier to scan and discuss.
- [Simple Tables and 'Runs on Atlassian' — Simpleasyty Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/runs-on-atlassian/): Understand where Simple Tables runs, how it handles data, and where to find published trust details.
- [Search — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/search-bar/): Search table rows across visible columns in Simple Tables for Confluence.
- [Sorting — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/sorting/): Enable, combine, and save column sorting in Simple Tables for Confluence.
- [Text Appearance — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/style-and-alignment/): Format table column text with style, horizontal alignment, vertical position, and text direction options.
- [Table colors — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/table-colors/): Set global table colors for headers, rows, borders, group rows, and footer totals in Simple Tables.
- [Table height — Simple Tables Docs](https://simpleasyty.com/simple-tables/docs/table-height/): Choose how much of a Simple Tables view stays visible before it scrolls vertically.
- [Cookie Policy — Simpleasyty](https://simpleasyty.com/trust-center/cookies/): Learn how Simpleasyty uses cookies and privacy-friendly analytics on our website.
- [Data Processing Agreement (DPA) — Simpleasyty](https://simpleasyty.com/trust-center/dpa/): Read Simpleasyty's Data Processing Agreement. Understand how we handle data protection and compliance.
- [Enterprise FAQ — Simpleasyty Trust Center](https://simpleasyty.com/trust-center/enterprise/faq/): Common questions enterprise teams ask while reviewing Simpleasyty.
- [End User License Agreement (EULA) — Simpleasyty](https://simpleasyty.com/trust-center/eula/): Understand the terms of the license for using Simpleasyty applications.
- [Platform Principles — Simpleasyty Trust Center](https://simpleasyty.com/trust-center/platform/principles/): The principles Simpleasyty follows when building Atlassian apps for enterprise customers.
- [Reliability — Simpleasyty Trust Center](https://simpleasyty.com/trust-center/platform/reliability/): Why customers can trust Simpleasyty applications over time.
- [Service Level Agreement (SLA) — Simpleasyty](https://simpleasyty.com/trust-center/sla/): Understand Simpleasyty's support commitment, response times, and availability expectations.
